audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gragas a neutral 'Skill' at levels 4-5 and hand level 6 to Ziggs. That is inverted against the packet chart (Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ziggs) and against the page's own whys: whys[3] says 'you farm and heal, he pokes and sieges' — that is Ziggs — and whys[4] literally opens with 'Skill:' and describes a real kill at 6.
audit.why: 43.84% over 203 games. Levels 4-5 are not neutral, and level 6 is the one stage where Gragas has a play; the chart currently says the reverse of both.
audit.corrected: Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ziggs — proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are already accurate and specific: his levels 1-3 poke, your level-6 E-Flash all-in, first-item one-combo, and full artillery late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is described correctly as the dash-canceller but its cooldown is never given (20/18/16/14/12s), and Hexplosive Minefield's flat 16s at every rank is absent too. Every engage instruction on the page says 'when it's down' without saying how long down is.
audit.why: A 20-second window at rank 1 is the entire reason level 6 is even winnable; a player who knows the number can count it, and one who doesn't just dashes into the knockback. The minefield being flat 16s at all ranks means it never gets easier to walk through — worth knowing before you plan a dive.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and knocks you out of your own Body Slam; Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank; your own R is 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and the Do's carry no numbers.
audit.why: This lane is nothing but cooldown counting — you get one commit per Satchel.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].d and wants.foe[2].

edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, and it knocks you out of your own dash. Engage the second it is spent. - Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank. - Your E is 14s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.
